name: Estonia — employment (tööleping)

changelog.summary: Statutory parental leave as a leave pay rule: unpaid by the employer, as the Social Insurance Board pays maternity and parental benefit; applied where the workspace has no parental leave rule of its own. Before, parental leave was paid in full unless a rule was added.

A month employment starts or ends: the social tax minimum is 886 x calendar days employed / 30 (SMS § 2 lg 3; määrus nr 17 § 6 lg 2); before, pay below the minimum was refused until the prorated base was entered. A refusal of work under TLS § 19, and pay certified by another employer, still need socialTaxMinimumBase.

Statutory sick pay as a leave pay rule: days 1-3 unpaid, days 4-8 at 70% paid by the employer, from day 9 unpaid as Tervisekassa pays (Health Insurance Act; Labour Inspectorate); applied where the workspace has no sick leave rule of its own. Before, sick days were paid in full unless a rule was added.

Leave pay rules: pay kept for sick days is the employer's sickness benefit, taxed with income tax only (EMTA, payment type 24); before, it was also charged social tax, unemployment insurance and funded pension. No social tax minimum for a month away on sick leave or leave other than unpaid leave by agreement (EMTA); a month of agreed unpaid leave without pay owes social tax on the minimum, which it did not before.

2026: income tax 22% with the flat 700 EUR monthly tax-free amount (776 EUR at pension age); unemployment insurance 1.6% / 0.8%; funded pension 2%, 4% or 6%; social tax 33% with the 886 EUR monthly minimum.

employee.description: Monthly tax-free amount from the employee's written application (TuMS § 42 lg 1): up to 700 EUR (0 without an application; one employer only, lg 2). From the year of reaching old-age pension age up to 776 EUR less what the pension already uses (§ 23^5, § 42 lg 1^3)
The employee reaches or has reached old-age pension age in this tax year (TuMS § 23^5): the tax-free amount may be up to 776 EUR
No employee unemployment insurance: from the month after reaching old-age pension age or being granted an early or flexible old-age pension (TKindlS § 42 lg 1 p 1); the employer's 0.8% remains
Mandatory funded pension (II pillar) contribution: 2%, or 4% or 6% if chosen (KoPS § 9); NONE if the employee is not a contributor
The employee also works for another employer: the social tax minimum is then paid only by the employer applying the tax-free amount (SMS § 2 lg 2^1)

The social tax minimum does not apply (SMS § 2 lg 4): shortened working time under TLS § 43 lg 4 or 6, parent of a child under 3 or of three or more children under 19, RaKS § 5 lg 4 p 5, within 12 months of hiring after at least six months registered unemployed, state pension recipient or partial/no work ability, local council member

Social tax minimum base in EUR replacing 886: for a month in which the employee started or left, or refused work under TLS § 19, 886 x calendar days worked / 30 (SMS § 2 lg 3; määrus nr 17 § 6); with another employer's pay certified, 886 less that pay (SMS § 2 lg 2^2; määrus nr 17 § 5)
The state pays social tax for this employee with partial or no work ability on the employer's application (SMS § 6 lg 1 p 5) — not supported

steps.message: Estonian payroll is monthly: the pay period must be a whole calendar month
Pre-tax deductions are not supported by this template
Employees for whom the state pays social tax (SMS § 6 lg 1 p 5) are not supported by this template
The monthly tax-free amount is at most 700 EUR (TuMS § 42 lg 1), or 776 EUR from the year of reaching old-age pension age (§ 23^5)

leavePay.note: Days 1-3 unpaid; days 4-8 the employer pays 70% of the average wage of the last six months (the rule pays 70% of the salary); from day 9 Tervisekassa pays, outside payroll.

Unpaid by the employer: the Social Insurance Board pays maternity and parental benefit, outside payroll. In part of a month away the social tax minimum still applies (SMS § 2 lg 3), unless the employee is exempt, e.g. as the parent of a child under 3 (socialTaxMinimumExempt). An employer paying on top of the benefit needs a workspace rule.

limitations: Employment contracts paid monthly in EUR in 2026, one payment per employee per month; taxation follows the payment date (EMTA: kassapõhine), and the tax-free amount and the social tax minimum are applied to this payment. A second run in the same month would apply them again.

The tax-free amount, pension age, the end of employee unemployment insurance, the funded-pension rate, other employment and the social tax minimum exemptions are entered per employee from the employee's application and the registers; they are not checked.

In a month the employee started or left, the social tax minimum is prorated (886 x calendar days employed / 30, määrus nr 17 § 6); for a refusal of work under TLS § 19 the prorated base must be entered; unpaid leave agreed by the parties does not reduce the minimum (SMS § 2 lg 3 p 1). The minimum belongs to the month containing the agreed pay day (määrus nr 17 § 2); pay made earlier or later than agreed (§ 3-4) and the final settlement (§ 7) are not reconciled across months.

Leave pay rules: pay kept for sick days is the employer's sickness benefit, taxed with income tax only (EMTA, payment type 24), assumed within the limit of the average wage; pay kept for other leave is wage. The social tax minimum is not applied for a month away on sick, maternity or other paid leave with a leave pay rule (EMTA), and applies in full for part of a month away and for unpaid leave by agreement (SMS § 2 lg 3). Leave of a type without a leave pay rule is not seen. Parental leave is unpaid by default: the Social Insurance Board pays the benefit, outside payroll.

Not modelled: the state-paid social tax for employees with partial or no work ability (SMS § 6 lg 1 p 5, refused), fringe benefits (erisoodustused), III pillar contributions paid by the employer, non-residents, seafarers and board members' fees, and other payments exempt from social tax (SMS § 3).
Contributions and the tax are rounded to the cent, half up, per line (TKindlS § 42 lg 3; EMTA examples).
Status LAW_DERIVED: values are cited from the consolidated acts, the 2026 State Budget Act and Government regulation nr 78/2025; the cases are derived from them.
